## Read first — critical review rules and current-version caveats

**Recommended reading:** A → E → F → G → B. Inspect C, D and Part F code appendices only when investigating concrete file/line questions. All original A–G materials are included *verbatim*, as are the complete supplied Cheeky upstream comparison patch and all nine source/licence files.

**Integrity checks passed:** E maps **42 added files**, all present in D; E maps **16 modified upstream files**, all represented in C. C and D are the original generated snapshot, not the complete upstream UEVR/UESDK repository.

**CRITICAL — Part F is not the newest Cheeky build.** Its code snapshot is the earlier Cheeky 0.6.3 NR Lite branch, whereas `liviutrn/OpenNR` has a newer branch `experiment/cheeky-v063-faithful-hdr-stability-20261110`, commit `1fd03a392d0a9652c7b52b2e05cc4dcf51314e7d` (10 Nov 2026, 15:07 UTC). That branch is 36 commits ahead of NR Lite, adding independent per-pass routing/crops, GPU timing, NR safety changes, and Faithful HDR reconstruction. **For latest Cheeky recommendations, Fable must inspect the newer branch's four implementation scripts and CI workflow, referenced below. This document does NOT contain the generated C++ source for the new branch.** Do not assume old Part F describes current NR behavior.

**CRITICAL — VectorXR Part G** describes public source/docs, not an inspected copy of the installed runtime binary; its version, depth/engine MV availability, settings and memory use remain unconfirmed.

**Evidence constraints:** [SRC] code, [LOG] logs, [HEADSET] VR user observation, [MEAS] measurement, [EST] estimate and [GUESS] hypothesis are *different*. Never treat a proposed optimization or CI pass as a headset-proven result. Private UESDK and original pinned upstream repos are not embedded. Report any dependency on them explicitly.

**Goal for Fable:** Critical source-grounded review with ranked CPU/GPU/VRAM/stability improvements; precise file/function/line citations; work-avoiding opportunities across 3 rendered sources; Cheeky view routing and NR placement; VectorXR and OpenXR depth interplay; low-FPS stability; no new temporal flicker or BSOD hazards. Separate verified defects, plausible explanations and experiments. Recommend at most three targeted headset tests.

Not included: upstream Joey UEVR code that we did not change (public: github.com/joeyhodge/UEVR @ 5ac7edc), the private UESDK (pin 3cffbc8, must never be published), Cheeky's NR plugin (separate DLL, ChatGPT's fork liviutrn/OpenNR), VectorXR.

## 1. Goal and owner
- Owner: Liviu. **Not a programmer.** Wants to PLAY STALKER 2 in VR at high resolution, fast and stable, not mod forever. Plain words, max 3 test questions per build, he tests in the headset.
- Goal: foveated VR rendering for demanding UE5 games via UEVR (Joey Hodge's fork): sharp high-res centre where the eye looks (PSVR2 eye tracking), cheap low-res wide periphery, stereo correct.
- Current product line: **TriView (rendering method ID 7)**: 3 real renders per frame = 1 shared mono periphery + 2 stereo foveas (left/right eye crops).
- Fallback product: DuoView Mono v207 (ID 6, two renders of one mono camera, no stereo depth) [HEADSET stable 31 Oct].

## 2. Hardware, game, settings
- STALKER 2 patch 2.10, UE 5.5.4, DX12. OpenXR via SteamVR, PSVR2 + PSVR2 Toolkit (eye tracking). RTX 5070 12 GB, Ryzen 5800X.
- SteamVR global 100 %, STALKER 2 per-app 250 % -> **4060x3228 per eye** at UEVR scale 1.0 [LOG].
- Liviu's TriView defaults (apply_liviu_defaults.py, last patch step): focus crop 0.6x0.6, periphery (context) scale 0.30, feather 0.10, gaze breakout 0.25, world scale 0.85, decoupled pitch, XYZ head scaling X3 Y1 Z1.5, etc. [SRC]
- In-game: DLSS SR Performance (native STALKER DLSS), **Cheeky DLSS 5 Neural Rendering (NR) plugin** (CheekyFoveatedDLSS.dll, UEVR plugin, NR before SR on the foveas), **VectorXR** (OpenXR frame-generation layer).
- **NO-GO (Liviu): never lower texture quality, never disable VectorXR frame gen, never disable Cheeky DLSS 5 NR.** Picture must not get worse.

## 3. Repo and build system
- Repo github.com/liviutrn/UEVR-Quad-Views-Mono (public). It holds **patch scripts, not a source tree**. CI (GitHub Actions, windows-2022) clones Joey UEVR 5ac7edc + private UESDK 3cffbc8 + uevr-frontend 60be4b0, runs the patch chain (Part B), builds the DLL, runs CTest (48 tests incl. WARP GPU pixel tests of the compositor), packages artifact `UEVR-TriView-B42-VRAM-<run#>`.
- Workflow `.github/workflows/triview-b1.yml`; triggers on push to `claude/triview-**`. Build ~30 min.
- Nothing compiles locally (private SDK). Local replay of the python patch chain works (fxc stub writes "DXBC"+124 bytes; skip verify_exact_baseline/verify_stage234/verify_stage1 which need the SDK) - this is how Parts C/D/E were produced.
- Branches: Claude only `claude/...`, ChatGPT `experiment/...`. Current: **claude/triview-b42-20261110 @ 76daf1f (B42.1)**, run 42785043946 green.
- Known flaky CI test: `quadview-edge-v2-production-gpu` (QuadViewEdgeV2GpuTests): fails ~1 in 2-3 runs (assertion "temporal=40 instant=40" or a ~4 s segfault), passes on rerun, root cause unknown [CI].
- Source of truth for headers: `quadview/*.hpp` in the repo are copied into `src/mods/vr/` by the chain (generated copy == repo copy). CTest compiles the repo copies.

## 4. Architecture: what happens in one TriView frame
(Order verified from code [SRC] and log lines [LOG] of Liviu's 10 Nov session.)

1. **Mode entry.** A saved ID7 profile loads as a *request*; the active mode starts as Joey's Native Stereo. Autostart (VR.cpp ~13827, `m_triview_autostart_stage`) warms up Native Stereo + Native Stereo Fix, then commits ID7 at a viewport boundary (`[Mono] Committed rendering method 7` [LOG]). Direct entry into ID7 without warm-up historically showed black [HEADSET].
2. **Game thread: views.** The stereo device hook `GetDesiredNumberOfViews` returns 4 in TriView (`quadview_desired_view_count()`, FFakeStereoRenderingHook.cpp ~32283). Roles: 0 = periphery (mono, centre camera, union FOV), 1 = unused placeholder (constructed, not rendered), 2 = left fovea, 3 = right fovea. Per-view projection/camera/crop come from QuadViewGeometry.hpp `make_layout` + gaze.
3. **Game thread: isolated renders.** `uevr::quadview::dispatch_main_views` (QuadViewFamilyRouting.hpp ~272-291, called at FFakeStereoRenderingHook.cpp ~26388) splits the family: for each role it selects ONE view + its OWN render target and calls the engine's BeginRenderingViewFamily with a one-view family. Each role gets its own frame number (`roles=9753,0,9754,9755 mask=13` [LOG]). => **3 complete UE scene renders per frame**, each with its own FSceneViewState/histories, its own DLSS SR evaluate. Reason: on 2.10 one-family stereo has bad shading and E1 failed; Lumen max 2 views per family; Native Fix does the same per eye.
4. **Placement rule (2.10).** A singleton family render lands at (0,0) of its target regardless of the view rect [CAPTURE, Build 52]. Hence every role has its own target, read at origin. Never use atlas X offsets.
5. **Native target set.** QuadViewNativeTargets / ResourceReuse / Retirement: a "set" = 3 colour targets (periphery e.g. 1218x968, foveas e.g. 2436x1937 each at crop 0.6 on 4060x3228) published per generation (`Published THREE independent UE5.5 source targets` [LOG]); fence-protected retirement; same-world reuse. Size changes go through `ResizeGate` (QuadViewGeometry.hpp): settle 400 ms, hold the live set meanwhile, latch/retry/timeout; B42 adds 1.5 s cooldown and a VRAM guard.
6. **NGX hooks (periphery depth).** QuadViewNgxDepth.hpp hooks NGX DLSS Evaluate/Create/Release + queue/command-list paths; on the periphery's DLSS evaluate it copies the DLSS input depth (in=813x646 for out=1218x968) into a snapshot pool (max 12 slots; measured 4 slots / 16 MB [LOG]) used for periphery depth reprojection (stereo-correct periphery per eye, jitter-aware). Depth-stencil sources are copied whole (D3D12 cannot sub-copy them).
7. **Cheeky NR** (separate DLL, ChatGPT's fork) hooks NGX too: inside each fovea's DLSS SR evaluate it runs NVIDIA NR (Feature 18) on the raw input before SR, per eye, sequentially. Enabling NR costs ~+0.9 GB VRAM at once [LOG 10 Nov].
8. **RHI tail -> compositor.** When the three role renders' RHI work has executed (`[QuadViews][RHI] native tail executed`), the D3D12 compositor (QuadViewD3D12.hpp + shaders, see Part D) builds each eye: periphery (reprojected with depth to that eye) underneath, the eye's fovea on top, edge/seam handling (B27 inward feather, B37 exterior, B40 continuous ambient edge colour matching, edge-V2 temporal history), focus lift / brightness matching, gamma tables, sharpen. Output into the OpenXR double-wide swapchain (8120x3228) (`[QuadView][CopyEnqueued]`, `[QuadView][Submit] eyes=2` [LOG]).
9. **Hold window** (TriViewHold.hpp, B41): if a frame is missing, re-submit the last image (still head-tracked) up to 250 ms instead of black.
10. **OpenXR submit** -> VectorXR frame generation -> SteamVR -> PSVR2. UI (Slate) goes to a dedicated 1024x768 target and its own layer [LOG].
11. **Gaze.** QuadViewPSVR2Gaze / QuadViewGaze: PSVR2 eye tracking moves the fovea crops, with stabilisation and breakout thresholds.

## 5. Measured numbers
- Fixed cost: **each separate render family ~7 ms GPU regardless of pixels; an extra view inside the same family ~2.5 ms** [MEAS 200x200]. => number of renders is the main lever, not pixels.
- 200x200/eye: Mono 68 fps, Native Stereo 58, Native+Fix 46, DuoView Mono 45, tri-view 34 [MEAS].
- 4060x3228/eye: TriView B41 **~26 fps**, GPU-bound (fps rises with NR off / smaller fovea) [LOG/HEADSET]; Native Stereo ~24 at 3.8k; stock AFW 38 (rejected for quality).
- VRAM (B42, 10 Nov): steady **~8.6 GB of a ~10.1 GB DXGI budget (85 %)**; Cheeky NR enable +0.9 GB -> 93-94 %; depth pool 16 MB [LOG]. Budget shrinks ~1 GB while other processes (SteamVR etc.) grow [LOG].
- B40 colour matching: Liviu sees 0.5-1 ms (32 lanes x 60 serial samples) [HEADSET/EST].
- Liviu measured NR before SR ~5 ms vs ~15 ms after SR [MEAS, as reported].

## 6. Stability history (most important open area)
- **BSOD 0x139 (KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE)** surge from 6 Nov (29 in 4 days, TriView B13+ era). Decisive test: periphery depth OFF + Cheeky NR OFF still BSOD; in the menu, spamming crop changes climbed VRAM until BSOD at ~10 GB => VRAM exhaustion (driver bug under overcommit) [HEADSET/LOG]. Growth source: UE allocates scene buffers per new view size while old ones live.
- Engine.ini `r.SceneRenderTargetResizeMethod=2` + ForceOverride stopped the climb but raised the start from 6.36 to 9.06 GB [LOG]; Liviu told to remove it.
- **B42/B42.1 (current)**: VRAM guard on resizes (refuse if used + 100 B/source px > 85 % budget), 0.05 size snapping, 1.5 s rebuild cooldown, low-resolution start (0.3, one live switch to 1.0 when loaded and VRAM allows), VRAM logs. Details: claude/handoff-b42-1-verify-20261110.md. **Low start and refusals not yet seen in a headset session.**
- B41.1 fixed black flashes: D3D12Hook refreshed m_device via GetDevice every frame (COM nulls the out pointer) -> other threads read nullptr -> false target rejections and rebuilds [LOG/SRC].
- 10 Nov CTD: Cheeky NR enabled (+0.9 GB), then NR foveation OFF (bigger NR image) -> out of VRAM -> crash [LOG]. Cheeky fix in progress by ChatGPT.
- Unexplained: "player moves by itself" once (no evidence yet).

## 7. History in one table (what failed and must not be repeated)
| Approach | Result | Lesson |
|---|---|---|
| QuadViews Builds 32-52 (4 views, atlas) | worked on 2.06, broke on 2.10 | 2.10 singleton renders land at (0,0): no atlas offsets |
| E1 one-family stereo | shading artefacts | per-eye families needed; **do not try one-family stereo** |
| DuoView AFW (PureDark warp) | fps fine, image rejected | quality |
| Synthetic stereo CI31-CI127 (depth-warped other eye) | 40 fps at 4.5k but doubled hands, edge jitter | artefacts |
| Third view as extra engine view index (proof builds) | head tracking broke ("theater screen") | Joey's 2-view bookkeeping; TriView uses isolated renders instead |
| Guessing UE struct offsets | harmful | never guess offsets |
| Stereo-atlas NR before SR | impossible: foveas are separate renders, each SR runs inside its own render | (10 Nov analysis) |
Full digest: project doc claude/failed-attempts-and-lessons-20261104.md.

## 8. Working rules (team)
- Claude and ChatGPT are one team; review each other; label every claim (source-read / CI / headset / estimate). No fake green: CI success is not a headset success.
- One build per real hypothesis, after local replay + an independent review. Check CI once when due.
- Liviu tests; at most 3 precise questions per build.
- Usage care: spend on thinking (root causes, design, review); avoid exploratory builds and repeated reads.

## 9. What we want from you (Fable)
Analyse the current TriView (B42.1) for the best **return on effort** in:
1. **Performance** (target: noticeably above ~26 fps at 4060x3228/eye without lowering image quality). Known ideas, unevaluated: periphery rendered every other frame with reprojection (est. 26 -> ~30 fps); fewer/cheaper passes in the per-role render (which UE features run 3x that could run once or cheaper on the periphery, e.g. via per-view show flags or cvars that don't change the picture); compositor cost (B40 colour matching 0.5-1 ms); CPU/render-thread overhead of 3 families.
2. **Stability**: remaining crash/BSOD risks (resize/reallocation paths, NGX hook interplay with Cheeky, lifetime/fence/retirement, threading), the automatic low-res -> full-res switch (new, untested), races (e.g. plain ints read cross-thread).
3. **VRAM**: where the ~8.6 GB goes and what can be freed without quality loss (UE per-view histories x3, retired sets, NR caches).
4. **Quality**: seam/edge, periphery tremble/jitter history, reprojection artefacts.
5. **Code health**: dead code from abandoned paths (QuadViews 4-view, DuoView) that still runs or costs, risky patterns.

Please deliver: a ranked list (impact x confidence / effort), each item with evidence (file:line from Parts C/D/E), a concrete change outline, risk, and how Liviu can verify it with at most 3 headset questions. Mark what you verified in code vs what you infer. If something needs a measurement first, say exactly which log line or number decides it.

# Part F — Cheeky DLSS Neural Rendering (our 0.6.3 NR Lite fork)

**Prepared:** 10 Nov 2026. **Status:** source inspection and exact source reconstruction; **not** a new headset benchmark or runtime certification.

**Evidence notation (same as Part A):** **[SRC]** source-read, **[LOG]** captured game/plugin log, **[MEAS]** Liviu's measurement, **[GUESS]** hypothesis/unverified runtime outcome. All technical assertions below carry one or more of these labels.

## 0. Pinned inputs, how to read this part

- **[SRC]** Our fork: [`liviutrn/OpenNR`, branch `experiment/cheeky-v063-triview-nr-lite-vram-20261110`](https://github.com/liviutrn/OpenNR/tree/experiment/cheeky-v063-triview-nr-lite-vram-20261110/CheekyPort), including [view-routing patch script](https://github.com/liviutrn/OpenNR/blob/experiment/cheeky-v063-triview-nr-lite-vram-20261110/CheekyPort/scripts/apply_v063_nr_view.py), [NR Lite patch script](https://github.com/liviutrn/OpenNR/blob/experiment/cheeky-v063-triview-nr-lite-vram-20261110/CheekyPort/scripts/apply_v063_nr_lite.py), [VRAM policy](https://github.com/liviutrn/OpenNR/blob/experiment/cheeky-v063-triview-nr-lite-vram-20261110/CheekyPort/include/nr_lite_budget_policy.hpp) and [Windows build workflow](https://github.com/liviutrn/OpenNR/blob/experiment/cheeky-v063-triview-nr-lite-vram-20261110/.github/workflows/cheeky-v063-nr-lite.yml). Checked fork patch commit `0918cb86f7e303c4b78f85be9cd27c2029ebea23`.
- **[SRC]** The workflow pins [upstream `ClarkCheekyKent/CheekyFoveatedDLSS` commit `39bfc96214498e5e21cf861f0eb21f875697b428`](https://github.com/ClarkCheekyKent/CheekyFoveatedDLSS/tree/39bfc96214498e5e21cf861f0eb21f875697b428) (v0.6.3), then runs **view script → NR Lite script → version-header correction** (`shared/version.h` 0.6.2→0.6.3).
- **[SRC]** [Full generated unified diff, all changed files](fable-F-cheeky-fork-vs-upstream.patch) (**15 files**, including dynamic changes to the Lua UI, full replacement of Cheeky's private SR function, copied headroom policy, and corrected version macro). This is a reconstruction of the CI-generated Cheeky source, **not** a comparison of the unrelated OpenNR/Skyrim source against Cheeky.
- **[SRC]** Full reconstructed relevant implementation, with original line numbering preserved inside each generated file: [hooks.cpp](fable-F-cheeky-source/src/hooks.cpp), [dlss_nr.cpp](fable-F-cheeky-source/src/dlss_nr.cpp), [dlss_nr_input.cpp](fable-F-cheeky-source/src/dlss_nr_input.cpp), [dlss_nr_input.hpp](fable-F-cheeky-source/src/dlss_nr_input.hpp), [nr_guides.hpp](fable-F-cheeky-source/src/nr_guides.hpp), [GPU lifetime .hpp](fable-F-cheeky-source/src/dlss_nr_lifetime.hpp), [GPU lifetime .cpp](fable-F-cheeky-source/src/dlss_nr_lifetime.cpp), and [crop_motion.cpp](fable-F-cheeky-source/src/crop_motion.cpp). The last four are unchanged upstream at this pin but included because they define GPU guide, queue/recording lifetime, and adjacent GPU allocation paths.
- **[SRC]** Exact string-match patch assertions passed during reconstruction; no source changes were made to TriView/UEVR, no binary was compiled and no VR tests were performed as part of this document. The fork's build/Windows test workflow is the independent executable validation route.

## 1. One frame in plain language

1. **[SRC]** The separate UEVR Cheeky DLL intercepts game DLSS-SR feature creation/evaluation and chooses whether to process each NGX view. **`EyeProcessingMode=3`** identifies the **two equal-geometry stereo foveas**, passing the dissimilar full-FOV mono periphery through to native SR; ambiguous mapping fails closed. It does **not** cause UEVR to render a fourth source. Mode `0` processes all DLSS views, including the periphery. See `src/hooks.cpp:5009–5017`, view-routing modifications in the diff, and `CheekyPort/V063_NR_VIEW_PORT.md`.
2. **[SRC]** In the **Before SR** configuration, `NativeNrInputScope` builds a `DlssNrFrame` from the game's NGX **Color, Depth, MotionVectors, Output**, input/output dimensions, crop and gaze data. It selects a private D3D12 raw-color texture and records **copy source color → NVIDIA NR Feature 18 → substitute processed Color NGX parameter → original native DLSS SR evaluate** on the current command list. Its scope restores the original NGX parameter afterwards. This happens separately for each fovea: `src/hooks.cpp:4781–4848, 4941–4960, 4962–5055`; `src/dlss_nr_input.cpp:53–188`.
3. **[SRC]** **Native STALKER 2 DLSS Super Resolution stays authoritative.** The NR Lite-generated `evaluate_native_d3d12_canonical` always returns `false` (private Cheeky SR path bypassed); the normal original NGX SR callback proceeds. See `src/hooks.cpp:4904–4918, 5028–5055`. If NR preparation fails, the original color is forwarded rather than blocking the game.
4. **[SRC]** NR Feature 18 gets its own state/history per **view ID and model pass**, model key and GPU scratch. It converts color/depth/motion into NR's expected inputs, evaluates NVIDIA's NGX NR, then decodes the result. One- or two-pass UI options are supported; a second pass has its own feature and optional output texture. See `src/dlss_nr.cpp:128–196, 420–570, 810–1000, 1124–1660`.
5. **[SRC]** This is **NOT an active two-eye atlas batch**. The `[CheekyNR][AtlasProbe]` merely reports handle and input order. A correct atlas would need verified same-frame left/right raw color, depth and motion **before either native SR call**, which is not established in this hook. See [stereo atlas handoff](https://github.com/liviutrn/OpenNR/blob/experiment/cheeky-v063-triview-nr-lite-vram-20261110/CheekyPort/STEREO_ATLAS_HANDOFF.md).
6. **[MEAS]** Liviu previously compared NR **before** SR (~5 ms) vs **after** SR (~15 ms) in this game/setup. These are his observations, not code-derived timings or guarantees at every resolution.

## 2. Interception and hook installation

- **[SRC]** Hooked public/core D3D12 NGX exports include `NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_Init`, `CreateFeature`, `EvaluateFeature`, `EvaluateFeature_C`, and `ReleaseFeature`. D3D11 counterparts are also implemented; the current STALKER 2 route is **D3D12**. `src/hooks.cpp:~3770–3959, 5826–5940`. The plugin separately obtains its private NGX NR Feature 18 create/evaluate/release functions through `GetProcAddress` on the model runtime (`src/dlss_nr.cpp:~291–410`).
- **[SRC]** The library discovers resident and late-loaded NGX DLLs, checks/stabilizes module exports, installs **inline/trampoline detours** on exports and **IAT/import substitutions** where applicable; a worker scans loaded modules after attachment. Streamline is intercepted through a separate inline hook path and safeguards against double-processing nested NGX calls. `src/hooks.cpp:~888–930, 1070–1100, 4940–5055, 5460–5950, 6440–6520, 6600–6635`. The game executable's `GetProcAddress` import is explicitly excluded on one interception path; don't characterize this as blanket detouring of every import.
- **[SRC]** Submission/reset/allocator bookkeeping feeds the NR lifetime tracker: `src/dlss_nr_lifetime.hpp:18–45`; `src/dlss_nr_lifetime.cpp:160–285`. The tracker observes recording identity and GPU queue fence completion; it is **not** a simple frame-count timer. Threading/hook interactions with TriView are a review target rather than a claim of proven stability.
- **[SRC]** `NVSDK_NGX_D3D12_AllocateParameters`, `CreateFeature`, `EvaluateFeature`, and `ReleaseFeature` used for the plugin's **own NR Feature 18** are calls into NVIDIA's runtime, distinct from calls intercepted on the game SR path (`src/dlss_nr.cpp:~291–410, 420–570, 1420–1600`).

| Resource and owner | Count / size | When retained or released | Evidence |

| Before-SR private color input, `dlss_nr_input.cpp` | Up to **4 slots per active DLSS view ID**, not 4 total; identical extent/format to incoming raw Color, 1 mip, UAV-enabled. Size = **D3D12 allocation-info bytes**, dependent on input resolution/format/alignment. | Reused after relevant command list is complete (or ordered in same recording); old/changed-format slots marked retired and freed only after recording/queue lifetime ends. | **[SRC]** `src/dlss_nr_input.cpp:11–43, 98–162, 190–225` |
| NR GPU scratch, `dlss_nr.cpp` | **8 cached `GpuResources` maximum per NR view/pass state**; original output, color proxy, neural output, optional pass-2 output, guides, descriptors/shaders; sizes derived from region, working scale and allocation format. **Not 8 buffers total across both eyes.** | Completed old-resolution resources retired; cold completed scratch trimmed after **3 seconds**, retaining a warm eligible idle set. Pass-2 scratch released when switching to 1 pass once GPU-safe. | **[SRC]** `src/dlss_nr.cpp:128–196, 597–667, 810–1000` |
| NR guide textures | Motion guide `R32G32_FLOAT` (**8 B/pixel**), depth guide `R32_FLOAT` (**4 B/pixel**); actual dimensions from the NR pass and GPU allocation alignment. | Owned by corresponding `GpuResources`. | **[SRC]** `src/nr_guides.hpp:11–55` |
| NVIDIA Feature 18 model and temporal history | **1 live NGX handle per view/pass** (potentially two passes per fovea). **0 spare reusable old features** by current policy, but in-flight retired handles may temporarily coexist. **Opaque NVIDIA allocation size unknown**. | Model-key changes create new features; old features released only when GPU work is finished. No forced drain/CPU stall to free them. | **[SRC]** `src/dlss_nr.cpp:153–196, 212–250, 420–570, 1124–1160` |
| GPU recording/queue fences | Dynamically associated with recording identities and all executing queues. | Released only when completed/reset safely; no assumption of triple buffering. | **[SRC]** `src/dlss_nr_lifetime.cpp:13–30, 107–145, 160–285` |
| Private Cheeky SR/FG textures | Private SR path bypassed, **Cheeky-owned FG forced off** in NR Lite; retained generic code does not mean those modes run each frame. | VectorXR has **separate** FG resources; Cheeky does not manage them. | **[SRC]** generated `hooks.cpp:4904–4918` and changes to `src/settings.cpp` / UEVR Lua in unified diff |

**[SRC]** The NR Lite VRAM log executes about **once every 2 seconds** (see `dlss_nr.cpp:263–300`), with **committed resource estimate** and counts, but excludes opaque NVIDIA-owned allocations:

```text
[CheekyNR][VRAM] scratchMiB=... scratchSets=... busyMiB=... busySets=... beforeMiB=... beforeSlots=... beforeBusyMiB=... beforeBusy=... beforeRetired=... ngxFeatures=... ngxRetired=... pass2Outputs=... (NGX opaque allocations excluded)
```

**[SRC]** `beforeMiB` is the sum of private raw-color inputs; `scratchMiB` counts known GPU scratch (color outputs, guides etc.); `busyMiB` and `beforeBusyMiB` are outstanding-recording portions, not additional allocations to add again. `ngxFeatures` counts **handles** not their unseen memory footprint. To determine the plugin's full cost, compare overall DXGI usage/budget before and after enabling NR.

**[SRC]** The CPU-only, non-atlas diagnostic samples first 32 hook calls and then every 256:
```text
[CheekyNR][AtlasProbe] seq=... view=... list=... color=... depth=... mv=... source=... input=... output=... offset=...
```
`hooks.cpp:4800–4812`. **[SRC]** A changing pointer or consecutive calls does not prove both eyes' resources are simultaneously GPU-ready.

**[SRC]** The `nr_lite_check_budget` **admission guard** runs before settings/template transactions that could reallocate an NR model. It queries local DXGI `usage/budget` and requires a **heuristic headroom reservation**; it leaves old settings/history untouched on rejection. The reservation is **not** a measured allocation: e.g. enabling foveated two-fovea NR requests **1,024 MiB** free, disabling NR foveation requires **2,304 MiB** for foveas (3,072 MiB for all views), and increasing from 1→2 passes requires **1,536 MiB** for foveas. It may still underestimate NVIDIA's opaque model memory. [Policy source](https://github.com/liviutrn/OpenNR/blob/experiment/cheeky-v063-triview-nr-lite-vram-20261110/CheekyPort/include/nr_lite_budget_policy.hpp), generated `uevr/runtime.cpp` in diff.

```text
[CheekyNR][VRAMGuard] approved action=... freeMiB=... reserveMiB=... nrFoveated=... passes=...
[CheekyNR][VRAMGuard] REJECTED action=... valid=... usedMiB=... budgetMiB=... freeMiB=... reserveMiB=... nrFoveated=... passes=...
```

**[LOG]** Part A reports about **8.6 GiB of a ~10.1 GiB DXGI budget** in one B42 session and about **+0.9 GiB** when NR was enabled. **[GUESS]** Neither number isolates Cheeky scratch from NVIDIA feature history or VectorXR and is **not** a memory profile of this newer NR Lite binary.

A combined derivative/binary requires a separate licence-compatibility and redistributability check. We did **not** copy NVIDIA proprietary runtime/model binaries or private UESDK.

## 7. Unknowns / checks Fable should not skip

- **[GUESS]** VRAM can still fail at small view sizes because opaque NGX per-feature history, delayed old model retirement, UE view histories and VectorXR buffers have non-pixel-fixed overhead. The code does **not** prove a total memory ceiling or successful headset stability.
- **[GUESS]** Two fovea evaluations remain sequential. The AtlasProbe is **not** proof of a safe frame-local stereo atlas; verify a UE5 callback before either SR evaluate before attempting one-call batching.
- **[SRC]** To attribute the crash: correlate **DXGI local usage/budget**, `[CheekyNR][VRAM]` and `[CheekyNR][VRAMGuard]`, native NR Feature 18 create/release lines, VectorXR's **Frame Generation process video memory**, and TriView's native target/resizing logs in one time window. Log correlation, not a guessed per-pixel formula, is the deciding evidence.

# Part G — VectorXR OpenXR frame-generation layer

**Prepared:** 10 Nov 2026. **Status:** public source/documentation research, **not** an inspection of Liviu's installed executable or new headset measurement.

**Evidence labels:** **[SRC]** directly read in public source/documentation, **[LOG]** observed in supplied runtime logs, **[MEAS]** Liviu measured it, **[GUESS]** inference or unverified for this particular installation. Technical claims use these labels, following Part A.

## 0. Pin and quick answer

- **[SRC]** Vendor/source: **DienerTech LLC**, [VectorXR repository](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr), public [v0.20.1 release notes](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/release/notes/v0.20.1.md), [usage guide](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/usage.md), [architecture](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/architecture.md), [licence](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/LICENSE). **Known public release documented: 0.20.1**; source lines below refer to **`master` as read 10 Nov 2026**, which may include post-release experimental work. They are **not** an assertion that every experimental master feature ships in v0.20.1.
- **[GUESS]** **Liviu's installed VectorXR version is not yet verified** in the logs reviewed for this handoff. The current binary's About page, installer version, or runtime startup banner is necessary to tie behavior to an exact compiled revision.
- **[SRC]** VectorXR is a **Windows OpenXR API layer** inserted between the VR application/UEVR and the OpenXR runtime. Its separate desktop app edits settings; the native layer performs frame pacing, optical flow, generated-frame output and OpenXR submission. It is **not** a DLSS/NGX plug-in, and **does not** require changes to TriView's render targets to operate.
- **[SRC]** Normal Frame Generation **reads the rendered per-eye color images**, can additionally use the game's submitted **depth** if present and validated, and normally **estimates motion from consecutive color images** using GPU shader block matching or NVIDIA hardware optical flow. **It does not use game motion-vector textures in the standard, user-facing FG path.** Current `master` includes a research-gated experimental engine-motion-vector path; this distinction is crucial below.

## 1. Loading and one-frame pipeline

1. **[SRC]** VectorXR registers an **implicit OpenXR API layer** on Windows. OpenXR's loader discovers its manifest and dispatches selected calls to its DLL. Source entry points are [`layer/src/layer_entry.cpp`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/layer/src/layer_entry.cpp) and [architecture](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/architecture.md#runtime-architecture). The config UI can enable/reorder OpenXR API layers; its process need not be running throughout game play.
2. **[SRC]** At `xrCreateSession`, the FG setting is latched for that OpenXR session. The layer tracks swapchains and image-acquire/release calls. It intercepts `xrWaitFrame`, `xrBeginFrame`, and `xrEndFrame`, in supported configurations running its own presenter thread. Its `FrameGenPresenter` knows which OpenXR projection image each eye submitted. Source [`docs/architecture.md` lines ~73–120](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/architecture.md) and [`layer/src/framegen/framegen_presenter.cpp`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/layer/src/framegen/framegen_presenter.cpp).
3. **[SRC]** FG captures the **final per-eye color swapchain image(s)**, with previous real frames, estimates optical flow on GPU shader cores (default) or on an NVIDIA optical-flow accelerator (optional), and synthesizes new frames into **layer-owned output swapchains**. Two modes: `Interpolate` mixes between real frames (usually smoother, some additional latency); `Extrapolate` predicts beyond the latest frame (less delay, more edge/reveal artifacts). **[GUESS]** TriView's rendered periphery/foveas are already composited into each eye's submitted image by this stage: VectorXR cannot independently reduce TriView's three UE render-family costs.
4. **[SRC]** If the projection view carries valid depth information (OpenXR's `XrCompositionLayerDepthInfoKHR`, `XR_KHR_composition_layer_depth`), FG can use that depth to account for stereo/head translation and improve sharpness near objects. The depth pipeline checks validity and relative-eye alignment; bad/missing/disabled depth falls back to color-derived flow. This works in **D3D12**, and in **D3D11/Vulkan via respective bridges** where compatible depth is submitted. The **0.20.1** release specifically added D3D11 bridge depth, including UEVR titles. [Usage guide lines ~765–841](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/usage.md#game-depth); [0.20.1 release notes](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/release/notes/v0.20.1.md).
5. **[SRC]** FG controls runtime pacing, presenting generated frames between or around genuine frames, potentially at `2x`, `3x`, `4x` or Dynamic-selected pacing. OpenXR `xrEndFrame` count and the game's real render FPS must be distinguished; the generated frames do not mean the game has rendered extra scene families.
6. **[GUESS]** Whether this specific STALKER 2 **D3D12 UEVR + TriView** session supplies usable projection-depth information to VectorXR has **not** been verified. TriView's **internal DLSS periphery depth snapshot** is not automatically the same thing as a depth image submitted through the OpenXR projection layer. Do not assume depth is active because TriView has a depth buffer.

## 2. Exactly what is read: color, depth, and game motion vectors

| Signal | Standard VectorXR FG | Evidence and important distinction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Real per-eye color** | **Required; read from OpenXR projection color swapchains** on every real frame. | **[SRC]** `FrameGenViewSubmission::source` in [`layer/include/depthxr/framegen_gpu.h`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/layer/include/depthxr/framegen_gpu.h), `FrameGenPresenter`, `docs/architecture.md`. |
| **Depth** | **Optional; automatically used when present, readable and valid**, unless `Use game depth` disabled. Usually attached by `XrCompositionLayerDepthInfoKHR` and processed in D3D12/bridges. | **[SRC]** [`layer/src/engine_motion.cpp`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/layer/src/engine_motion.cpp), [`docs/usage.md`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/usage.md#game-depth); `depthUsed` in 30-second summaries and OSD `uses depth` are practical evidence. |
| **App/engine motion-vector image** | **Not used in the normal released FG path**; movement is inferred by matching color across successive frames. | **[SRC]** Usage guide, `docs/usage.md` section **Current limits**, explicitly says it does not use game motion vectors yet. NVIDIA **optical flow** is **not** the same as native UE5 scene motion vectors. |
| **Experimental engine vectors in `master`** | **Code exists, off by default, for research.** A `VECTORXR_FRAMEGEN_ENGINE_MV` environment switch can request `census`, `capture`, `observe`, `assist`, or `lead`; `off` is default. This may consume OpenXR space-warp vector swapchains in special circumstances. | **[SRC]** [`layer/src/framegen/framegen_presenter.cpp:~621–645`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/layer/src/framegen/framegen_presenter.cpp) reads the research switch; [`layer/include/depthxr/framegen_plan.h:~733–746`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/layer/include/depthxr/framegen_plan.h) declares modes; [`layer/include/depthxr/framegen_gpu.h:~87–110`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/layer/include/depthxr/framegen_gpu.h) defines optional game-vector job. **[GUESS]** No evidence Liviu enabled this experimental mode or that his installed binary includes it. |

**[SRC]** Short example from [DienerTech VectorXR, `layer/src/engine_motion.cpp:~52–59`](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/layer/src/engine_motion.cpp), provided under MPL-2.0, showing detection of an OpenXR depth extension in a submitted structure chain:

```cpp
const XrCompositionLayerDepthInfoKHR* LeadingDepth(const void* next) {
    for (auto* node = static_cast<const XrBaseInStructure*>(next); node; node = node->next) {
        if (node->type == XR_TYPE_COMPOSITION_LAYER_DEPTH_INFO_KHR) {
            return reinterpret_cast<const XrCompositionLayerDepthInfoKHR*>(node);
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}
```

**[SRC]** The existence of this parser does **not** demonstrate that the actual STALKER 2 session supplied depth. **[GUESS]** Without `depthUsed`/OSD/session logs, quality or VRAM changes attributed to depth would be speculation.

## 3. Frame-generation settings relevant to our setup

- **[SRC]** FG enable/disable per app, default profile normally off; changes to enabling FG and some bridge settings require restart.
- **[SRC]** **Mode:** `Interpolate` (default, better continuity with delay) or `Extrapolate` (lower added delay, more errors).
- **[SRC]** **Rate:** `Dynamic` (default, app runs as fast as its pacing allows, FG fills missing displays; can stand down) versus `Fixed: Auto / 2x / 3x / 4x` (holds app at a refresh divisor). In a 120Hz headset, **[GUESS]** 4x generally targets a ~30Hz real-frame budget *if* runtime actually runs at 120Hz and the path supports 4x. Never infer a fixed 4:1 multiplier from arbitrary decimal FPS ratios.
- **[SRC]** **Motion source:** `Shader` (default) or NVIDIA `hardware` optical flow. Under Interpolate, **Fall back to Shader when hardware can't keep up** defaults on; Extrapolate uses the selected flow source. These are not input options for game motion vectors.
- **[SRC]** **Advanced:** `Use game depth`; flow quality `Performance` (~1/16 image), `Balanced` (~1/8, default), `Quality` (~1/4); artifact suppression (default 50/100); motion limit (default 10% of view width); diagnostic views, OSD and A/B binding. [Usage guide, settings section](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/usage.md#frame-generation-settings).
- **[SRC]** Output-image pools persist for the session after creation so changing dynamic/fixed rate may **not** immediately return VRAM. [Usage guide rate and memory](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/usage.md#frame-rate-dynamic-or-fixed).

## 4. VRAM use: known values vs Liviu's unknown

**[SRC]** VectorXR's [own VRAM documentation](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/usage.md#video-memory) (illustrative documented budgets, **not measured here**):

| At **per-eye resolution** | Kept real images | Generated-output images | Typical total FG budget |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **3000×3000** | ~**0.1 GB per kept real frame** | ~**0.2 GB**, both eyes' output swapchains | **Under 1 GB** total in cited configuration |
| **6864×6908** | ~**0.55 GB per kept real frame** | ~**1.1 GB**, both eyes' output swapchains | **~3–4 GB** total for D3D12, ~4–5 GB if D3D11/Vulkan bridge image copies needed |

**[SRC]** In just-in-time mode it keeps **five** real frames if the local memory budget permits, otherwise **three**, with different fallback for non-just-in-time sessions; an individual stored frame is approximated at **6 bytes per pixel per eye** across color + reduced-resolution depth/trust/flow. The layer adds its own swapchain output images (normally **three images × 4 bytes/pixel × two eyes**), flow/depth processing buffers, and possible bridge copies. Fixed higher multipliers can demand additional output images. **Do not add 0.55 GB five times without checking the session resolution.**

**[GUESS]** At Liviu's logged **4060×3228 per eye**, rough pixel-area scaling places VectorXR's D3D12 working/storage allocation around **0.7–1.3 GB** depending on the number of retained frames/output images, padding and optional features. This is a **planning estimate only**, not a measured breakdown: the game's actual submitted swapchain size and FG allocation strategy can differ. Even with TriView's **mono periphery**, VectorXR sees two final full-size eye images.

**[SRC]** Obtain the **real** answer from a VectorXR session log: search for **`Frame Generation process video memory`** lines, which distinguish process local usage/budget from FG's own working/output images; check **`Frame Generation keeps the last 5 real frames`** (or 3) and session flags **`justInTime`** plus **`twinMiB`** on bridge routes. [Source doc lines ~888–908](https://github.com/DienerTech/vectorxr/blob/master/docs/usage.md#video-memory). **[LOG]** The Part A VRAM ~8.6GB + NR ~0.9GB was an overall/NR-enablement observation and does not isolate VectorXR's retained frame pool.

3. **[SRC]** Record **`Frame Generation process video memory`** (owned working bytes and output images vs process DXGI budget) before/after VectorXR FG. **[GUESS]** This may account for a material portion of the 12GB pressure and is the only reliable way to quantify the part controllable by VectorXR rather than Cheeky/UE.

+bool VR::is_quadview_supported_title() const {
+    // Hook installation occurs at startup, before ID7 is selected.
+    // Cache title support independently of the active rendering mode.
+    static const bool stalker2_ue55 = [] {
+        const auto path=utility::get_module_pathw(utility::get_executable());
+        const auto detected_version=sdk::search_for_version(utility::get_executable()).value_or(L"0.00");
+        const auto file_version=sdk::get_file_version_info();
+        return path && uevr::games::is_stalker2_ue55_runtime(*path,detected_version,file_version.dwFileVersionMS);
+    }();
+    return stalker2_ue55;
+}

+const char* VR::quadview_unavailable_reason() const {
+    if (!is_quadview_mode_selected() && requested_rendering_method() != RenderingMethod::QUAD_VIEWS_STEREO) return nullptr;
+    if (!m_is_d3d12 || g_framework == nullptr || !g_framework->is_dx12()) return "Quad Views requires DX12";
+    const auto runtime = get_runtime();
+    if (runtime == nullptr || !runtime->is_openxr()) return "Quad Views requires OpenXR";
+    if (!is_quadview_supported_title()) return "Quad Views currently supports STALKER 2 UE5.5 only";
+    if (!m_fake_stereo_hook || !m_fake_stereo_hook->quadview_view_extensions_ready())
+        return "Quad Views warming up: scene-view constructor hook is not ready";
+    // Stay in the previous working rendering mode until the real renderer
+    // entry callback has executed. ID7 OpenXR requires a four-view image.
+    if (!m_fake_stereo_hook || !m_fake_stereo_hook->quadview_outer_renderer_observed())
+        return "Quad Views warming up: outer renderer interception not observed";
+    if (m_extreme_compat_mode->value() || m_splitscreen_compatibility_mode->value() || m_2d_screen_mode->value() ||
+        m_sceneview_compatibility_mode->value() || m_stereo_emulation_mode) return "Quad Views requires Extreme Compatibility, split-screen, 2D Screen, SceneView compatibility and Stereo Emulation OFF";
+    if (uevr::nascar::is_target()) return "Quad Views is unavailable for this title's restricted rendering path";
+    return nullptr;
+}

+        m_triview_b42_low_start_state.store(2, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+        m_triview_b42_last_used_mb.store(mb(used), std::memory_order_relaxed);
+        m_triview_b42_last_need_mb.store(mb(estimate), std::memory_order_relaxed);
+        m_triview_b42_last_limit_mb.store(mb(vram::limit_bytes(budget, limit_percent)), std::memory_order_relaxed);
+        SPDLOG_WARNING_EVERY_N_SEC(10, "[TriView][LowStart] staying at {:.2f}: switch to {:.2f} needs ~{} MB, used {} MB, limit {} MB ({:.0f}% of {} MB)",
+            warm, full, mb(estimate), mb(used), mb(vram::limit_bytes(budget, limit_percent)), limit_percent, mb(budget));
+        return;
+    }
+    spdlog::info("[TriView][VRAM] before resolution switch: used {} MB / budget {} MB, estimate {} MB", mb(used), mb(budget), mb(estimate));
+    if (m_openxr->finish_triview_warmup("TriView loaded and VRAM allows it")) {
+        m_triview_b42_low_start_state.store(3, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    } else if (runtimes::OpenXR::triview_warmup_scale.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) <= 0.f) {
+        // Live switch not allowed by UEVR for this engine: stay low now, and do not
+        // start low again next time (the user would otherwise be stuck low).
+        m_triview_b42_low_start->value() = false;
+        m_triview_b42_low_start_state.store(4, std::memory_order_relaxed);
+        spdlog::warn("[TriView][LowStart] live switch refused by UEVR; low-resolution start turned OFF for next starts");
+    }
+}

+
+// Update the immutable state from persisted controls only on changes.
+void VR::configure_duoview() {
+    // Validate ALL independent settings separately. Do not let one invalid
+    // option veto any other valid controls. Latch the reconciled immutable
+    // Settings atomically on the next UE frame; never alter native source size.
+    const auto current = m_duoview.settings();
+    uevr::duoview::Settings candidate{
+        .crop_width=m_duo_width->value(), .crop_height=m_duo_height->value(),
+        .peripheral_scale=m_duo_periphery->value(), .foveal_density=m_duo_density->value(),
+        .feather_fraction=m_duo_feather->value(), .debug_border=m_duo_border->value(),
+        .eye_tracked=m_duo_gaze->value(), .fovea_view=static_cast<uint32_t>(m_duo_fovea_view->value()),
+        .diagnostic_view=static_cast<uint32_t>(m_duo_debug_source->value()),
+        .gpu_timing=m_duo_timing->value(), .direct_xr_output=m_duo_direct_xr->value(), .stabilize_crop=m_duo_stabilize->value(),
+        .guard_fraction=m_duo_guard->value(), .independent_shading=false,
+        .native_fix_same_pass=m_duo_native_fix->value(),
+        .gaze_quant_pixels=static_cast<uint32_t>(m_duo_quant->value()),
+        .gaze_hold_ms=m_duo_hold->value(), .gaze_reacquire_samples=m_duo_reacquire->value(),
+        .gaze_offset_u=m_duo_offset_x->value(), .gaze_offset_v=m_duo_offset_y->value(),
+        .gaze_micro_gain=m_duo_micro_gain->value(),
+        .gaze_breakout_radius=m_duo_breakout->value(),
+        .gaze_still_radius=m_duo_stillness->value(),
+        .gaze_relock_samples=static_cast<uint32_t>(m_duo_relock->value())};
+    const auto checked=uevr::duoview::reconcile_ui_settings(candidate,current);
+    candidate=checked.settings;
+    m_duo_ui_rejected_mask.store(checked.rejected,std::memory_order_release);
+    if (checked.rejected) {
+        SPDLOG_WARNING_EVERY_N_SEC(5,
+            "[DuoView][Controls] Rejected invalid UI fields mask=0x{:X}; "
+            "other valid controls continue; active quality width={:.3f} height={:.3f} periphery={:.3f} density={:.3f}",
+            checked.rejected,candidate.crop_width,candidate.crop_height,
+            candidate.peripheral_scale,candidate.foveal_density);
+    }
+    if (current.crop_width==candidate.crop_width && current.crop_height==candidate.crop_height &&
+        current.peripheral_scale==candidate.peripheral_scale && current.foveal_density==candidate.foveal_density &&
+        current.feather_fraction==candidate.feather_fraction && current.debug_border==candidate.debug_border &&
+        current.eye_tracked==candidate.eye_tracked && current.fovea_view==candidate.fovea_view &&
+        current.diagnostic_view==candidate.diagnostic_view && current.gpu_timing==candidate.gpu_timing &&
+        current.direct_xr_output==candidate.direct_xr_output &&
+        current.stabilize_crop==candidate.stabilize_crop && current.guard_fraction==candidate.guard_fraction &&
+        current.independent_shading==candidate.independent_shading &&
+        current.native_fix_same_pass==candidate.native_fix_same_pass &&
+        current.gaze_quant_pixels==candidate.gaze_quant_pixels &&
+        current.gaze_hold_ms==candidate.gaze_hold_ms &&
+        current.gaze_reacquire_samples==candidate.gaze_reacquire_samples &&
+        current.gaze_offset_u==candidate.gaze_offset_u &&
+        current.gaze_offset_v==candidate.gaze_offset_v &&
+        current.gaze_micro_gain==candidate.gaze_micro_gain &&
+        current.gaze_breakout_radius==candidate.gaze_breakout_radius &&
+        current.gaze_still_radius==candidate.gaze_still_radius &&
+        current.gaze_relock_samples==candidate.gaze_relock_samples) return;
+    if (!m_duoview.configure(candidate))
+        SPDLOG_WARNING_EVERY_N_SEC(2, "[DuoView][Controls] Internal validated settings rejected; retaining prior frame and reporting for diagnosis");
+}
+
+// Stage 5: sample native PSVR2 gaze ONCE per immutable source frame.
+ // CAPI unavailable or invalid => fixed center. Never adjust mid-frame.
+bool VR::is_quadview_renderer_active() const {
+    return is_quadview_layout_active() && quadview_unavailable_reason() == nullptr;
+}
+
+bool VR::is_quadview_layout_active() const {
+    const auto key=quadview_key();
+    const auto demand=m_quadview_draw_demand.get(key.generation,key.draw_serial);
+    return demand && demand->source_admission;
+}
+
+bool VR::is_duoview_renderer_active() const {
+    if (!is_using_duoview_mono() || !m_is_d3d12 || m_duoview_quarantined.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) return false;
+    const auto runtime = get_runtime();
+    if (!runtime || !runtime->is_openxr()) return false;
+    static const bool stalker2 = [] {
+        const auto path = utility::get_module_pathw(utility::get_executable());
+        return path && uevr::stalker2_native::is_executable(*path);
+    }();
+    return stalker2;
+}
+
+bool VR::is_duoview_or_triview_fov_active() const {
+    if (is_duoview_renderer_active()) return true;
+    // ID7 committed (not merely requested). Same title/API/runtime limits as DuoView.
+    if (!is_quadview_mode_selected() || !m_is_d3d12) return false;
+    const auto runtime = get_runtime();
+    if (!runtime || !runtime->is_openxr()) return false;
+    static const bool stalker2 = [] {
+        const auto path = utility::get_module_pathw(utility::get_executable());
+        return path && uevr::stalker2_native::is_executable(*path);
+    }();
+    return stalker2;
+}
+
+std::optional<uevr::duoview::ViewFrame> VR::duoview_begin_frame() {
+    if (!is_duoview_renderer_active() || !m_fake_stereo_hook ||
+        !m_fake_stereo_hook->is_in_viewport_client_draw()) return {};
+    std::call_once(m_duoview_settings_once, [this] { configure_duoview(); });
+    const auto runtime = get_runtime();
+    if (const auto candidate=m_duoview_candidate_key.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
+        if (candidate->generation==mono_generation()) {
+            if (const auto found=m_duoview.snapshot(*candidate)) return found;
+        }
+    }
+    const auto source_frame = runtime->internal_frame_count;
+    if (!get_openxr_runtime() || !get_openxr_runtime()->has_mono_pose(source_frame)) {
+        set_mono_status("Waiting: DuoView has no exact OpenXR Mono pose token yet");
+        return {};
+    }
+    const auto key = duoview_key();
+    auto projection = get_projection_matrix(VRRuntime::Eye::LEFT);
+    const float near_plane=sdk::globals::get_near_clipping_plane();
+    if (!std::isfinite(near_plane) || near_plane<=0.f) return {};
+    projection[3][2]=near_plane;
+    std::array<float, 16> frozen{};
+    std::memcpy(frozen.data(), &projection[0][0], sizeof(frozen));
+    const auto eye=get_eye_transform(0);
+    const std::array<float,9> optical{
+        eye[0][0],eye[0][1],eye[0][2],
+        eye[1][0],eye[1][1],eye[1][2],
+        eye[2][0],eye[2][1],eye[2][2]};
+    const auto settings=m_duoview.settings();
+    m_duoview_gaze.set_recovery_controls(static_cast<uint32_t>(settings.gaze_hold_ms),
+        static_cast<uint32_t>(settings.gaze_reacquire_samples));
+    auto frame=m_duoview.begin(key, get_hmd_width(), get_hmd_height(), frozen,
+        [this, frozen, optical]() -> std::optional<uevr::duoview::UV> {
+            return m_duoview_gaze.read_uv(frozen,optical);
+        }, GetTickCount64(), source_frame);
+    if (frame) m_duoview_candidate_key.store(
+        std::make_shared<const uevr::duoview::FrameKey>(key), std::memory_order_release);
+    return frame;
+}
+
+std::optional<uevr::quadview::Snapshot> VR::quadview_begin_frame() {
+    if (m_triview_world_epoch_gate.closed()) {
+        set_quadview_status("World recovery: source admission closed until XR callbacks and world identity are ready");
+        return {};
+    }
+    const bool renderer_active=is_quadview_renderer_active();
+    const bool hook_available=m_fake_stereo_hook!=nullptr;
+    const bool viewport_draw=hook_available && m_fake_stereo_hook->is_in_viewport_client_draw();
+    if (!renderer_active || !viewport_draw) {
+        const char* reason=!is_quadview_mode_selected() ? "mode_not_selected" :

+        return {};
+    }

+            key.generation,key.draw_serial,m_render_frame_count);

+            requested.focus_brightness=m_quadview_focus_brightness->value();
+            requested.focus_lift_strength=m_quadview_focus_lift_strength->value();
+            requested.focus_corner_gain=m_quadview_focus_corner_gain->value();
+            requested.focus_lift_onset=m_quadview_focus_lift_onset->value();
+            requested.focus_lift_power=m_quadview_focus_lift_power->value();
+            requested.seam_mode=static_cast<uint32_t>(m_quadview_seam_mode->value());
+            requested.seam_strength=m_quadview_seam_strength->value();
+            requested.seam_max_gain=m_quadview_seam_max_gain->value();
+            requested.seam_brightness_ev=m_quadview_seam_brightness_ev->value();

+            requested.edge_reach_px=m_quadview_edge_reach->value();
+            requested.edge_fast_px=m_quadview_edge_fast->value();
+            requested.edge_rate=m_quadview_edge_rate->value();
+            requested.edge_hysteresis=m_quadview_edge_noise->value();

+            draw_config.settings_revision=m_quadview_settings_revision;

+                0.5*std::abs(pose
+                    ? double(pose->quadview_head_views[1].pose.position.x)-double(pose->quadview_head_views[0].pose.position.x)
+                    : double(get_eye_offset(VRRuntime::Eye::RIGHT).x)-double(get_eye_offset(VRRuntime::Eye::LEFT).x))*
+                    double(get_world_to_meters()),
+                double(m_quadview_depth_strength->value()));
+            // B10: exact eye origins in the rendered left-optical context basis.
+            if (candidate->shared_context && pose && pose->stage_views.size()==2 && draw_config.base_projection_valid) {
+                const auto& q=pose->stage_views[0].pose.orientation;
+                const double x=q.x,y=q.y,z=q.z,w=q.w;
+                const double norm=x*x+y*y+z*z+w*w;
+                const double units=get_world_to_meters();
+                if (std::isfinite(norm) && std::abs(norm-1.)<1.e-3 && std::isfinite(units) && units>0.) {
+                    const double r[3][3]{{1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-z*w),2*(x*z+y*w)},
+                        {2*(x*y+z*w),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-x*w)},
+                        {2*(x*z-y*w),2*(y*z+x*w),1-2*(x*x+y*y)}};
+                    const auto& l=pose->stage_views[0].pose.position;
+                    const auto& rr=pose->stage_views[1].pose.position;
+                    const double center[3]{(l.x+rr.x)*.5,(l.y+rr.y)*.5,(l.z+rr.z)*.5};
+                    std::array<std::array<double,3>,2> origins{};
+                    for (size_t eye=0;eye<2;++eye) {
+                        const auto& t=pose->stage_views[eye].pose.position;
+                        const double delta[3]{t.x-center[0],t.y-center[1],t.z-center[2]};
+                        for(size_t axis=0;axis<3;++axis) for(size_t j=0;j<3;++j)
+                            origins[eye][axis]+=r[j][axis]*delta[j]*units*(axis==2 ? -1. : 1.);
+                    }
+                    std::array<double,16> context{};
+                    for(size_t i=0;i<16;++i) context[i]=draw_config.projections[0][i];
+                    context[0]=candidate->context_projection[0];context[8]=candidate->context_projection[1];
+                    context[5]=candidate->context_projection[2];context[9]=candidate->context_projection[3];
+                    (void)uevr::quadview::configure_depth_geometry(*candidate,context,origins,double(m_quadview_depth_strength->value()));
+                }
+            }
+            // Tri-view B6: use compact per-role targets for this draw only when a
+            // matching live set is already published; otherwise keep the atlas layout.
+            // Only READ the published set here (lock-free): ensure() may spawn actors and
+            // flush rendering and must not run under m_quadview_layout_mutex. The request
+            // and the liveness check happen after the freeze, outside the lock.
+            if (true) {
+                auto compact=*candidate;
+                const auto compact_rtm=m_fake_stereo_hook->get_render_target_manager();
+                if (uevr::quadview::apply_native_local(compact) && compact_rtm && is_quadview_supported_title()) {
+                    // Tri-view B14: the same snapshot the size hold looked at.
+                    const auto set=m_triview_hold_set;
+                    if (set && set->extents==uevr::quadview::triview_source_extents(compact) && set->complete()) {
+                        *candidate=compact;
+                        m_triview_resize_gate.confirm_live(set->extents,{draw_config.settings.crop_width,draw_config.settings.crop_height,
+                            draw_config.settings.context_scale,draw_config.settings.foveal_density});
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+            layout=m_quadview_layout_latch.freeze(key.generation,key.draw_serial,*candidate);
+            m_quadview_draw_config_key=key; m_quadview_draw_config=draw_config;
+            {
+                std::scoped_lock pose_lock{m_quadview_pose_mutex};
+                m_quadview_pose_key=key; m_quadview_pose=std::move(pose); m_quadview_pose_eye_mask=0;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    if (!layout) {
+        set_quadview_status("No frozen structural layout is available for this draw");
+        SPDLOG_WARNING_EVERY_N_SEC(2,"[QuadViews][GTBegin][per-call-throttled] reason=frozen_layout_unavailable generation={} draw={} frame={}",
+            key.generation,key.draw_serial,m_render_frame_count);
+        return {};
+    }
+    if (!layout->shared_context) {
+        set_quadview_status("TriView requires a valid shared periphery pose; skipping this draw (QuadView fallback disabled)");
+        return {};
+    }
+    const auto rtm = m_fake_stereo_hook->get_render_target_manager();
+    std::shared_ptr<const VRRenderTargetManager_Base::QuadViewNativeTargetSetSnapshot> native_target_set{};
+    // Tri-view B6: while compact sources are ON always request the compact set (no
+    // thrash between atlas and compact sizes); the draw follows its frozen layout.
+    auto requested_extents=uevr::quadview::triview_source_extents(*layout);
+    if (true && !layout->native_local) {
+        auto compact=*layout;
+        if (uevr::quadview::apply_native_local(compact)) requested_extents=uevr::quadview::triview_source_extents(compact);
+    }
+    if (true && m_triview_pending_extents_valid) requested_extents=m_triview_pending_extents;
+    if (rtm && is_quadview_supported_title() && rtm->ensure_quadview_native_target_set(requested_extents))
+        native_target_set=rtm->get_quadview_native_target_set();
+    // Tri-view B14: this draw's sizes were chosen against m_triview_hold_set. If a
+    // build published (or is still building) in between, keep drawing from that
+    // held set: it is still owned here and retires through the fenced owner path.
+    // Same world only; with no published set (world change) the old rule applies.
+    if (rtm && m_triview_hold_set &&
+        (!native_target_set || native_target_set->extents!=uevr::quadview::triview_source_extents(*layout))) {
+        const auto published=rtm->get_quadview_native_target_set();
+        const auto& hold=m_triview_hold_set;
+        if (published && published->world_identity==hold->world_identity && hold->complete() &&
+            hold->extents==uevr::quadview::triview_source_extents(*layout) && rtm->quadview_native_targets_live(*hold)) {
+            if (published.get()!=hold.get())
+                SPDLOG_INFO_EVERY_N_SEC(1,"[TriView][Resize] new set published during this draw; drawing it from the held set");
+            native_target_set=hold;
+        }
+    }
+    m_triview_hold_set.reset();
+    const bool native_target_ready=native_target_set &&
+        native_target_set->extents==uevr::quadview::triview_source_extents(*layout) && native_target_set->complete();
+    {   // Tri-view B7: which DLSS output is the periphery (0 = unknown or a fovea has the same size).
+        const auto& c=layout->views[0]; const auto& f=layout->views[2];
+        const bool usable=layout->shared_context && !uevr::quadview::ngx::matches_periphery(f.width,f.height,c.width,c.height);
+        uevr::quadview::ngx::PeripheryDepth::self().set_expected(usable ? c.width : 0u, usable ? c.height : 0u);
+    }
+    if (layout->native_local && !native_target_ready)
+        SPDLOG_WARNING_EVERY_N_SEC(2,"[QuadViews][Compact] compact layout frozen but its target set is no longer live (generation={} draw={})",
+            key.generation,key.draw_serial);
+    draw_config.native_target_set_ready=native_target_ready;
+    draw_config.native_target_set_generation=native_target_ready ? native_target_set->generation : 0;
+    draw_config.native_target_set=native_target_ready ? native_target_set : nullptr;
+    { std::scoped_lock lock{m_quadview_layout_mutex}; if (m_quadview_draw_config_key==key && m_quadview_draw_config) {
+        m_quadview_draw_config->native_target_set_ready=draw_config.native_target_set_ready;
+        m_quadview_draw_config->native_target_set_generation=draw_config.native_target_set_generation;
+        m_quadview_draw_config->native_target_set=draw_config.native_target_set; } }
+    if (!native_target_ready) set_quadview_status("Four-source native targets are warming up; this draw keeps the complete legacy family");
+    const auto target = rtm != nullptr ? rtm->get_view_family_render_target() : nullptr;
+    if (!m_quadview.begin(key, 0, reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target), 0, *layout,draw_config.settings,draw_config.settings_revision,draw_config.gaze)) {
+        if (const auto snapshot = m_quadview.snapshot(key)) return snapshot;
+        set_quadview_status("Waiting for a fresh four-view producer transaction");
+        SPDLOG_WARNING_EVERY_N_SEC(2,"[QuadViews][GTBegin][per-call-throttled] reason=producer_begin_rejected generation={} draw={} frame={} target={:x} revision={}",
+            key.generation,key.draw_serial,m_render_frame_count,reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target),draw_config.settings_revision);
+        return {};
+    }
+    m_quadview_candidate_key.store(std::make_shared<const uevr::quadview::Key>(key), std::memory_order_release);
+    set_quadview_status("Waiting for four engine view histories and main-family raster");
+    return m_quadview.snapshot(key);
+}
+
+std::optional<uevr::quadview::Layout> VR::quadview_layout_for_hooks() {
+    const auto key=quadview_key();
+    if (is_quadview_renderer_active() && m_fake_stereo_hook && m_fake_stereo_hook->is_in_viewport_client_draw())
+        (void)quadview_begin_frame();
+    {
+        std::scoped_lock lock{m_quadview_layout_mutex};
+        if (const auto layout=m_quadview_layout_latch.get(key.generation,key.draw_serial)) return layout;
+    }
+    const auto fallback=uevr::quadview::make_layout(get_hmd_width(),get_hmd_height(),.50f,.50f,.20f,1.0f,.50f,.50f);
+    if (!fallback) return {};
+    std::scoped_lock lock{m_quadview_layout_mutex};
+    return m_quadview_layout_latch.freeze(key.generation,key.draw_serial,*fallback);
+}
+
+void VR::duoview_abort(const char* reason) {
+    if (!is_using_duoview_mono()) return;
+    SPDLOG_WARNING_EVERY_N_SEC(2, "[DuoView] Quarantining two-view path; continuing original Mono inside ID6: {}", reason);
+    m_duoview_quarantined.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
+    m_duoview.retire();
+    if (m_fake_stereo_hook) m_fake_stereo_hook->duoview_delivery.retire(mono_generation());
+    m_duoview_candidate_key.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
+    m_duoview_frozen_key.store(nullptr, std::memory_order_release);
+    set_mono_status("DuoView fault: rendering original Mono inside ID6; reselect ID6 to retry");
+}

+static void sample_triview_vram(VR* vr) {

+    static std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point next_sample{};
+    static IDXGIAdapter3* adapter = nullptr;
+    static LUID adapter_luid{};
+    const auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
+    if (now < next_sample) return;

+        const auto depth_usage = uevr::quadview::ngx::PeripheryDepth::self().pool_usage();
+        SPDLOG_INFO_EVERY_N_SEC(2, "[QuadViews][VRAM] game process: {} MB used / {} MB budget ({:.0f}%); in system memory {} MB; depth pool {} slots {} MB",
+            local.CurrentUsage >> 20, local.Budget >> 20, local.Budget ? 100.0 * double(local.CurrentUsage) / double(local.Budget) : 0.0,
+            system.CurrentUsage >> 20, depth_usage.first, depth_usage.second >> 20);
+    }

+void D3D12Component::OpenXR::prepare_quadview_compositors(ID3D12Device* device, DXGI_FORMAT source_format,
+    UINT64 timestamp_frequency) {
+    // Prewarm outside copy(): no pipeline/heap/allocation creation in its callback.
+    std::scoped_lock lock{mtx};
+    auto it=contexts.find((uint32_t)runtimes::OpenXR::SwapchainIndex::DOUBLE_WIDE);
+    if (it==contexts.end()) return;
+    if (source_format==DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_TYPELESS) source_format=DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
+    if (source_format==DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_TYPELESS) source_format=DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
+    const auto& hook=g_framework->get_d3d12_hook();
+    ID3D12CommandQueue* const queue=hook ? hook->get_command_queue() : nullptr;
+    if (!quadview_edge_history || quadview_edge_history->device.Get()!=device || quadview_edge_history->queue.Get()!=queue)
+        quadview_edge_history=uevr::quadview::dx12::EdgeHistoryState::create(device,queue);
+    auto& context=it->second;
+    for (size_t i=0; i<context.texture_contexts.size() && i<context.textures.size(); ++i) {
+        auto& tc=context.texture_contexts[i];
+        if (!tc || !tc->commands.references_retired() || !context.textures[i].texture) continue;
+        auto& comp=quadview_compositors[&tc->commands];
+        if (!comp) comp=std::make_unique<uevr::quadview::dx12::Compositor>();
+        comp->on_slot_retired();
+        auto output_format=context.textures[i].texture->GetDesc().Format;
+        // The existing DOUBLE_WIDE swapchain is requested as BGRA8 sRGB;
+        // runtimes may expose its resource with a typeless family format.
+        if (output_format==DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_TYPELESS) output_format=DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM_SRGB;
+        if (output_format==DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_TYPELESS) output_format=DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM_SRGB;
+        if (!comp->prewarm(device,source_format,output_format,timestamp_frequency))
+            SPDLOG_WARNING_EVERY_N_SEC(2,"[QuadView][Prewarm] {}",comp->error());
+        comp->set_edge_history(quadview_edge_history);
+    }
+}

+static bool hook_trace_enabled() {
+    static const bool enabled = [] {
+        char value[8]{};
+        const DWORD len = GetEnvironmentVariableA("UEVR_VERBOSE_HOOK_TRACE", value, DWORD(sizeof(value)));

+    return enabled;

+void emit_hook_trace(size_t site,const HookTraceRecord& r) {

+    static HookTraceGate gate;

+        r.event,r.generation,r.serial,r.frame,r.role,r.mode,r.reason,site,decision.count,GetCurrentThreadId(),

+void FFakeStereoRenderingHook::dump_duoview_delivery() const {
+    static std::atomic<uint64_t> next_dump{};
+    const auto now = GetTickCount64();
+    auto expected = next_dump.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
+    if (now < expected || !next_dump.compare_exchange_strong(expected, now + 5000)) return;
+    const auto events = duoview_delivery.recent();
+    spdlog::warn("[DuoView][Delivery] No same-transaction RHI source pair on Present; recent bounded trace follows");
+    for (size_t i=events.size()-24; i<events.size(); ++i) {
+        const auto& e=events[i];
+        if (e.sequence) spdlog::warn("[DuoView][Trace] seq={} us={} event={} gen={} serial={} family={} role={} thread={} command={:x} target={:x} draw={} pose={} capture_gen={}",
+            e.sequence, e.time_us, static_cast<uint32_t>(e.event), e.generation, e.serial,
+            e.frame, static_cast<uint32_t>(e.role), e.thread, e.command, e.target, e.draw, e.pose, e.capture_generation);
+    }
+}

+    static void service_after_present(ID3D12CommandQueue* command_queue) noexcept {

+                            owner->retire_fence=queue.signal_fence;
+                            owner->retire_fence_value=value;
+                            owner->retire_fence_device_identity=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(queue.signal_device.Get());
+                        }

+                        while (flight_tail && flight_tail->next_retired) flight_tail=flight_tail->next_retired;
+                        if (flight_tail) {
+                            flight_tail->next_retired=queue.in_flight_head;
+                            queue.in_flight_head=signal_head;
+                        }

+                        queue.last_successful_fence=reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(queue.signal_fence.Get());

+                        queue.last_successful_signal_observed=true;

+        }

+            catch (...) { /* The next GT target service drains the completed list. */ }
+        }
+    }

+    uint64_t generation{};
+    uintptr_t world_identity{};
+    uint32_t width{},height{};
+    std::array<std::array<uint32_t,2>,4> extents{}; // Tri-view B6
+    std::array<std::shared_ptr<QuadViewNativeTargetOwner>,4> owners{}; // New allocations only.
+    std::array<std::shared_ptr<const SceneCaptureTargetSnapshot>,4> reused{};

+};
+
+float VRRenderTargetManager_Base::quadview_native_capture_display_gamma(const sdk::FRenderTarget*) {
+    // A table can outlive its owner/world. The callback never follows the
+    // viewport or manager pointer; GT refreshes the scalar for live targets.
+    return quadview_cached_display_gamma.load(std::memory_order_relaxed);
+}
+
+void VRRenderTargetManager_Base::service_quadview_native_target_retirements_after_present(ID3D12CommandQueue* command_queue) {
+    QuadViewNativeTargetOwner::service_after_present(command_queue);
+}
+
+uevr::quadview::NativeRetirementDiagnostics VRRenderTargetManager_Base::get_quadview_native_retirement_diagnostics() const {
+    return QuadViewNativeTargetOwner::diagnostics_snapshot();
+}
+
+bool VRRenderTargetManager_Base::quadview_native_targets_live(const QuadViewNativeTargetSetSnapshot& targets) const {
+    if (!GameThreadWorker::get().is_same_thread() || !targets.generation || !targets.world_identity) return false;
+    auto* engine=sdk::UGameEngine::get();
+    if (!engine || reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(engine->get_world())!=targets.world_identity) return false;
+    for (size_t i=0;i!=4;++i) {
+        if (i==1) continue; // No physical right periphery in TriView.
+        const auto& snapshot=targets.target_owners[i];
+        if (!snapshot || !snapshot->owner_lifetime) return false;
+        const auto owner=std::static_pointer_cast<const QuadViewNativeTargetOwner>(snapshot->owner_lifetime);
+        Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Device> owner_device{};
+        const auto* hook=g_framework ? g_framework->get_d3d12_hook().get() : nullptr;
+        const bool current_device=owner && owner->native_resource && hook &&
+            SUCCEEDED(owner->native_resource->GetDevice(IID_PPV_ARGS(&owner_device))) &&
+            owner_device.Get()==hook->get_device();
+        // A single rejected native target must never be dispatched. Distinguish
+        // benign world reallocation from same-world resource identity changes.
+        const bool generation_matches=owner &&
+            owner->resource_allocation_generation==snapshot->resource_allocation_generation;
+        const bool render_target_matches=owner && owner->render_target==targets.render_targets[i];
+        const bool owner_live=generation_matches && current_device &&
+            render_target_matches && owner->live();
+        if (!owner_live) {
+            const char* reason=!owner ? "missing-owner" :
+                !generation_matches ? "allocation-generation-mismatch" :
+                !current_device ? "D3D12-device-mismatch" :
+                !render_target_matches ? "render-target-identity-mismatch" :
+                "Unreal-owner-property-resource-or-hook-mismatch";
+            static std::atomic<uint64_t> b41_rejections{0};
+            const auto rejection_count=b41_rejections.fetch_add(1,std::memory_order_relaxed)+1;
+            // B41: which part of the device check failed (no extra work on success).
+            const bool has_native=owner && owner->native_resource;
+            const auto* hook_device=hook ? hook->get_device() : nullptr;
+            Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Device> probe_device{};
+            const HRESULT device_hr=has_native ? owner->native_resource->GetDevice(IID_PPV_ARGS(&probe_device)) : E_POINTER;
+            SPDLOG_ERROR_EVERY_N_SEC(1,"[TriView][TargetLifetime] rejected source role={} allocation={} publication={} reason={} target={:x} "
+                "native_resource={} hook={} hook_device={:x} get_device_hr={:#x} resource_device={:x} live={} rejections_total={}",
+                i, snapshot->resource_allocation_generation, targets.generation,
+                reason, reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(targets.render_targets[i]),
+                has_native, hook!=nullptr, reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(hook_device), static_cast<uint32_t>(device_hr),
+                reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(probe_device.Get()), owner && owner->live(), rejection_count);
+            return false;
+        }
+    }
+    return true;
+}
+
+bool VRRenderTargetManager_Base::ensure_quadview_native_target_set(const std::array<std::array<uint32_t,2>,4>& extents) {
+    // Tri-view B6: per-role extents (compact sources) or four equal 2W x H atlases.
+    constexpr std::array<size_t,3> tri_roles{0,2,3};
+    const bool extents_valid=extents[1][0]==0 && extents[1][1]==0 &&
+        std::all_of(tri_roles.begin(),tri_roles.end(),[&](size_t i) {
+            const auto& e=extents[i];
+            return e[0] && e[1] && e[0]<=16384 && e[1]<=8192;
+        });
+    const uint32_t width=extents_valid ? extents[0][0] : 0, height=extents_valid ? extents[0][1] : 0;
+    QuadViewNativeTargetOwner::servicing_enabled.store(true,std::memory_order_release);
+    if (GameThreadWorker::get().is_same_thread()) QuadViewNativeTargetOwner::drain_retired();
+    const auto vr=VR::get();

+// B42: one-shot switch from the low-resolution start to the saved scale, same
+// path as the menu slider (VR::on_openxr_resolution_scale_changed).
+bool OpenXR::finish_triview_warmup(const char* reason) {
+    if (this->view_configs.empty()) return false; // keep the warm-up until sizes are known
+    const float warm = triview_warmup_scale.exchange(0.f);
+    if (warm <= 0.f) return false;
+    const float full = this->resolution_scale->value();
+    const auto old_w = this->get_width_for_scale(warm), old_h = this->get_height_for_scale(warm);
+    const auto new_w = this->get_width_for_scale(full), new_h = this->get_height_for_scale(full);
+    spdlog::info("[TriView][LowStart] {}: resolution scale {:.2f} -> {:.2f} [{}x{}] -> [{}x{}]",
+        reason ? reason : "", warm, full, old_w, old_h, new_w, new_h);
+    if (old_w == new_w && old_h == new_h) return true;
+    auto vr = VR::get();
+    const bool live = vr != nullptr && vr->on_openxr_resolution_scale_changed(old_w, old_h, new_w, new_h);
+    if (live) {
+        this->resolution_scale_live_apply_deferred = false;
+        this->last_applied_resolution_scale = full;
+        this->last_applied_resolution_width = new_w;
+        this->last_applied_resolution_height = new_h;
+    } else {
+        this->resolution_scale_live_apply_deferred = true;
+        this->last_applied_resolution_scale = warm;
+        this->last_applied_resolution_width = old_w;
+        this->last_applied_resolution_height = old_h;
+        spdlog::warn("[TriView][LowStart] live resolution change not allowed; staying at {:.2f} until the next start", warm);
+    }
+    return live;
+}

+std::optional<OpenXR::PipelineState> OpenXR::capture_quadview_pose(uint32_t frame) {
+    auto pose=capture_quadview_current_pose();
+    if (!pose || pose->frame_count!=frame) return {};
+    return pose;
+}
+
+std::optional<OpenXR::PipelineState> OpenXR::capture_quadview_current_pose() {
+    std::scoped_lock lock{this->sync_assignment_mtx};
+    if (!quadview_latest_located_pose.get()) return {};
+    const auto& pose=*quadview_latest_located_pose.get();
+    if (!pose.quadview_locate_serial || pose.stage_views.size()!=2 || !pose.quadview_pose_valid ||
+        pose.frame_state.predictedDisplayTime<=0 || pose.frame_state.shouldRender!=XR_TRUE) return {};
+    const auto& h=pose.view_space_location.pose.orientation;
+    const double head_norm=double(h.x)*h.x+double(h.y)*h.y+double(h.z)*h.z+double(h.w)*h.w;
+    if (!std::isfinite(head_norm) || std::abs(head_norm-1.0)>.01) return {};
+    for (const auto& view : pose.stage_views) {
+        const auto& p=view.pose.position; const auto& q=view.pose.orientation; const auto& f=view.fov;
+        const double norm=double(q.x)*q.x+double(q.y)*q.y+double(q.z)*q.z+double(q.w)*q.w;
+        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||
+            !std::isfinite(norm) || std::abs(norm-1.0)>.01 ||
+            !std::isfinite(f.angleLeft) || !std::isfinite(f.angleRight) ||
+            !std::isfinite(f.angleUp) || !std::isfinite(f.angleDown) ||
+            f.angleLeft>=f.angleRight || f.angleDown>=f.angleUp) return {};
+    }
+    const auto& hp=pose.view_space_location.pose.position;
+    if (!std::isfinite(hp.x) || !std::isfinite(hp.y) || !std::isfinite(hp.z)) return {};
+    for (const auto& view : pose.quadview_head_views) {
+        const auto& p=view.pose.position; const auto& q=view.pose.orientation;
+        const double norm=double(q.x)*q.x+double(q.y)*q.y+double(q.z)*q.z+double(q.w)*q.w;
+        if (!std::isfinite(p.x) || !std::isfinite(p.y) || !std::isfinite(p.z) ||
+            !std::isfinite(norm) || std::abs(norm-1.0)>.01) return {};
+    }
+    return pose;
+}
